title: The Zscaler SDKs against ZCC: where their behavior is described

prose.text: Method tables are generated: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <query>` for a module's methods, a Go package's functions and the endpoints they call. The surface has no method parameters: filters such as `list_devices`' `username`, `list_admin_users`' `user_type`, the web policy `list_by_company`'s `search_type`, the `search` filter on the forwarding-profile and web-app-service lists, and `get_passwords`' `username` and `os_type` are documented in each method's docstring in the vendored SDK. These subjects hold the client behavior around them; the API itself is in [[zcc.api]].

prose.label: Python client.
prose.text: The OneAPI and legacy clients are in [[zcc.sdk-python.client-configuration]], paging in [[zcc.sdk-python.pagination]], key casing and the parameter mapper in [[zcc.sdk-python.wire-keys]], and return values in [[zcc.sdk-python.return-shapes]].

prose.label: Go SDK.
prose.text: The request helper and the v1 and v2 paging helpers are in [[zcc.sdk-go.paging-and-requests]], and legacy-mode routing in [[zcc.sdk-go.legacy-routing]].

prose.label: By area.
prose.text: Forwarding profiles: [[zcc.api.forwarding-profile-wire]]. Web policies: [[zcc.api.web-policy-wire]]. Trusted networks: [[zcc.api.trusted-networks-wire]]. Web privacy: [[zcc.api.web-privacy-wire]]. Company info and password management: [[zcc.api.company-wire]]. Entitlements: [[zcc.sdk-python.entitlements]]. Device removal: [[zcc.devices.removal-api]].
